justification: We're not blowing this up over a bad Sunday or a box score Kris Jenner wants to laugh at. Mark Andrews had a quiet night but he ran his routes and did his job, so he gets his week to respond like he always does around here. Rico Dowdle's the same story — five carries, four catches, nothing flashy, but a kid who shows up and earns his snaps doesn't lose his spot to a bigger number on somebody's spreadsheet, so Corum stays behind him on the bench a little longer. The Chargers D got run over out there, 341 yards worth, but I watched them play their hearts out with 67 tackles trying to get a hand on everybody — that's not a unit that quit, that's a unit that'll be better for it, so they start again. Kirk Cousins, Omarion Hampton, Travis Etienne, Amon-Ra, Keenan Allen — all professionals who've done their jobs week in and week out, and Courtland Sutton's earned his seat right behind Keenan whenever his number gets called. Clear eyes, full hearts, same lineup, same belief.
